observations.name: blocked
observations.detail: Observed 1 enrolled node, no two-exit forwarding baseline. The shared stack has one runnable node and no exported second-node enrollment hook; SEEDED_NODE_2_ID in docs/e2e/README.md is a synthetic fixture forbidden by D-050. Single-exit native selection/skip_auto_apply is recorded in forwarding traces. Two-exit switch/death, relay/direct, UDP/QUIC and PMTU fixtures are unavailable; physical second NAT needs an operator run. No bridge-only traffic is counted as exit traffic.
